name: simmode
steps: log SIM MODE in the browser: both sides CPU, the spectator camera and overlay. Waits on GAME time (headless runs ~4-8 fps).

eval (async () => { const m = await import('./js/sim/zone.js'); const Z = m.createZone({ pure: true }); let worst = 0; for (let i = 0; i < 4000; i++) { const x = (i * 7919 % (Z.GRID.EXT*2)) - Z.GRID.EXT + (i % 13) * 0.37, z = (i * 104729 % (Z.GRID.EXT*2)) - Z.GRID.EXT + (i % 7) * 0.53; worst = Math.max(worst, Math.abs(Z.exact(x, z) - __G.terrainH(x, z))); } window.__terr = worst; return { worstTerrainDiff: worst }; })()

eval ({ t: Math.round(__G.war.time), units: __G.war.units.length, blue: __SIM.T.decisions.filter(d => d.side === 1).map(d => d.what).slice(-5), red: __SIM.T.decisions.filter(d => d.side === 2).length, own: __G.war.islands.map(i => i.owner).join(''), cam: __SIM.cam, shot: __SIM.shot && __SIM.shot.text, fps: document.getElementById('dbg').textContent })

eval ({ t: Math.round(__G.war.time), own: __G.war.islands.map(i => i.owner).join(''), strike: __SIM.SW && __SIM.SW.stats, events: __SIM.events.length, camAboveGround: __G.zCam.position.y - Math.max(__G.terrainH(__G.zCam.position.x, __G.zCam.position.z), 0) })
